steps.en: Open the Chinese README (or the English sibling) and read it top to bottom
steps.zh: 打开中文 README（或英文版），从头往下读

steps.en: Warns first that the numbers are correlations, cannot be added up, and some studies disagree
steps.zh: 先提醒：数字只是相关、不能相加、部分研究互相矛盾

steps.en: Lists about twenty habits, each with its reported change in all-cause mortality
steps.zh: 列出约二十个习惯，每条标出报告的全因死亡率变化

steps.en: Pick a habit you care about and jump to its evidence entry
steps.zh: 挑一个你在意的习惯，跳到它的证据条目

steps.en: Shows a popular write-up, usually the original study link, and the quoted numbers
steps.zh: 给出一篇科普转述，多数附原始研究链接和摘录的数字

steps.en: Open the original study, judge whether it applies to you, then change the habit
steps.zh: 打开原始研究，判断是否适用于自己，再调整习惯

value.en: One page ranks everyday habits by reported mortality effect, each number traceable to a source — no more collecting advice article by article
value.zh: 一页纸按报告的死亡率效应排好日常习惯，每个数字都能追到出处——不用再一篇篇攒养生建议

sources: README.md → headings "### 4. 分析", "### 5. 行动", "### 6. 证据" (the code values are these headings, verbatim)
README.md → 4. 分析: "变量无法简单叠加", "存在矛盾观点", "研究仅表达相关"
README.md → 5. 行动: per-habit ACM deltas, e.g. "喝咖啡（-22%\~-12% ACM）"
README.md → 6. 证据: entries shaped as a Zhihu/news link, then "出处：" with the study link, then quoted figures
